note: Harvey Park District park (Wells County) on the northwest edge of town at Hwys 3 and 52, beside the outdoor pool: camping loops with electric at the RV sites and water at some, a tent area, restrooms, grills, picnic shelters and a playground; rail line nearby. The rate is camper-reported (RV Life review, September 2024); the Park District has no web page. --Claude
